name: WNBA_R3A_SIGNAL_CUSTODY_AUDIT_V1
objective: Determine which preregistered R3 signal families are historically reconstructible from frozen 2021-2025 WNBA assets without reading target-game outcome values, and which must remain partial, blocked, or prospective-only.
anti_leakage_rules: The probe may inspect Parquet schema names and Parquet metadata row counts only.
The probe may not project or deserialize team_score, opponent_team_score, winner, linescore or any target-game outcome value.
Presence of score columns in schema may certify later prefix feasibility only; it does not authorize target-row outcome use.
Every historical feature used later must be constructed strictly from games finalized on official dates before the target date.
Current ESPN injury or current team aggregate endpoints cannot be backfilled as historical truth.
No family may enter R3 combination testing unless this audit classifies its historical custody as READY or separately freezes an explicit partial definition.

pre_probe_expected_constraints.AVAILABILITY_STAR_POWER: PROSPECTIVE_ONLY unless separately timestamped historical injury/player-availability custody is certified.
pre_probe_expected_constraints.BASE_R2: READY by prior R1/R2 custody and used only as fixed reference.
pre_probe_expected_constraints.FATIGUE_TRAVEL_V2: Prefix fatigue is expected reconstructible from dates/home-away; actual venue-sequence travel remains pending schedule schema/coordinate custody.
